about_the_game:
Tales of Miravia

A fantasy RPG where you play as a hero destined to purify corrupted statues and restore balance to the world of Miravia.

Key Features:

✨ Immersive Exploration
Dive into a richly detailed world with diverse maps and secrets to uncover.

⚔️ Turn-Based Strategic Combat
Face challenging enemies using unique tactics and abilities in thrilling battles.

🎮 Varied Minigames
Enjoy side activities that enhance the overall gameplay experience.

🌤️ Dynamic Visual Effects
Experience changing weather, realistic shadows, and immersive animations that heighten the action.

📖 Engaging Storyline
Follow a deep, captivating narrative with unforgettable characters and unexpected plot twists.

Note: Tales of Miravia is a game in constant development. Your support and feedback are crucial for improving and expanding the game.

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 o superior.
  • Processor: Intel o AMD de 64 bits.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: arjeta gráfica NVIDIA, AMD (RADEON 8500 o superior) o Intel.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: SO: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600 o AMD Ryzen 1600X.
